chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked: “What is the name of the mountain of Arafah upon which the people stand?”

key_terms.أَلَالٌ: the reported name of the mountain
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.عَرَفَةَ: Arafah, the sacred place associated with the standing in hajj

ai.seo_question: What is the name of the mountain at Arafah where people stand according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith records a brief question posed to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام regarding the name of the mountain at Arafah where the pilgrims stand. The Imam عليه السلام answers by identifying its name as Alāl, preserving a specific detail connected to the rites and geography of hajj.
